freeway_aadt_2019.note: Checks only, never fitted. Modelled = mean vehicles per matched freeway edge (entered + departed) in the window; expected = AADT 2019 x the median share of a SCATS approach's 23 Oct day count that falls in the window. Different year, a single day vs an annual average; order-of-magnitude only.
